frontmatter.name: esp32
frontmatter.description: Expert Embedded Systems guidance for ESP32 hardware, ESP-IDF firmware, and PlatformIO projects. Use for chip selection (S3, C3, C6, etc.), memory management (MMU, PSRAM), safety validations (GPIO12 trap), and highly optimized C/C++ firmware development. Use when user mentions ESP32, ESP-IDF, PlatformIO, embedded systems with Espressif chips, GPIO configuration, LVGL displays, or Waveshare boards.
